message.reasoning_content:
MegaWidgets Corp is a known vendor on file since May 2, 2024. No earlier invoices or aliases were found.

Three reject-severity findings were found: a total mismatch and two stock exceeded issues. The invoice must be rejected. The low-risk memo does not override these decisive findings.

The rejection reasons will cite each finding ID. F1 shows a $110 arithmetic shortfall: line items and tax total $15,635.00, but the invoice total is $15,525.00. F2 rejects WidgetA at 20 units against 15 in stock. F3 rejects WidgetB at 15 units against 10 in stock.
